'''2020 TMW Final Four Joe Olson LS Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Final Four).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Olson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Final Four
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut|Endor-L-endorchiefchirpashut.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
